note: Bases from the Muv-Luv Wiki missing from the war map (Locations category and the United Nations Force Bases page). Load with Restore from backup.

zone-andamanbase.name: Andaman Base Group (Port Blair)
zone-andamanbase.description: UN 1st Force base group across the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, built by India from 1978 and completed in 1985 with Port Blair at its heart. A staging point for the Indochina front and a stopover for refugees from Southeast Asia: Camp Parsa refugee camp and its pilot school share South Andaman, and Austin Base sits in Middle Andaman. Home of the 215th Tactical Armored Battalion.

zone-colombo.name: Colombo Base
zone-colombo.description: UN 1st Force base on Ceylon, south of the Indian subcontinent. It covers the Indian Ocean approaches alongside the Andaman Base Group.

zone-vancouver.name: Vancouver Base
zone-vancouver.description: UN 1st Force base on the Pacific coast of North America.

zone-candia.name: Candia Base (Crete)
zone-candia.description: UN 2nd Force base on Crete, south of the Aegean and Greece. An island outpost within reach of the Ankara Hive.

zone-guadeloupe.name: Guadeloupe Base
zone-guadeloupe.description: UN 4th Force base in the French Caribbean. Well known for its recreational facilities; Project PROMINENCE crews visited on a morale drive in 2001.

zone-iwakuni.name: Iwakuni Base
zone-iwakuni.description: Headquarters of the UN 11th Force, which guards the Far East Defence Line from bases shared with the Imperial forces.

zone-atsugi.name: Atsugi Base
zone-atsugi.description: UN 11th Force base near Yokohama. Home of the 404th Tactical Armored Battalion.

zone-nerima.name: Nerima Base
zone-nerima.description: UN 11th Force base in Tokyo. Home of the 303rd Tactical Armored Battalion, veterans of Operation Lucifer.

zone-misawa.name: Misawa Air Base
zone-misawa.description: UN 11th Force air base in northern Honshu.

zone-sasebo.name: Sasebo Base
zone-sasebo.description: UN 11th Force naval base in Kyushu, facing the Tsushima Strait and the Korean front.

zone-kadena.name: Kadena Air Base
zone-kadena.description: UN 11th Force air base on Okinawa (listed on the wiki as Kaneda).

zone-clark.name: Clark Base
zone-clark.description: UN 12th Force base on Luzon, operating with COSEAN forces in Southeast Asia.

zone-borneobase.name: Borneo Base
zone-borneobase.description: UN 12th Force base on Borneo, operating with COSEAN forces in Southeast Asia.

zone-c01.name: Ц-01 Frontline Supply Base
zone-c01.description: Northernmost of the Soviet Far East Army's Ц-series supply depots along the Sredinny Range, part of the Kamchatka District Defence Line against the Evensk Hive.

zone-c02.name: Ц-02 Frontline Supply Base
zone-c02.description: Soviet Ц-series supply depot on the Sredinny Range, part of the Kamchatka District Defence Line.

zone-c03.name: Ц-03 Frontline Supply Base
zone-c03.description: Soviet Ц-series supply depot on the Sredinny Range, the last link north of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky since Ц-04 was levelled in 2001.

zone-montstmichel.name: Mont Saint-Michel Fortress
zone-montstmichel.description: European Union base network around Mont Saint-Michel, Saint-Malo and the fortified Channel Islands. The Benedictine monks stayed on through the fighting to give frontline troops spiritual guidance.

zone-rosalamos.name: Ros Alamos
zone-rosalamos.description: US research centre for G-element studies, working on the remains of the Athabasca landing under Dr. William Gray.
